title: Stateful Start service explicit request
purpose: Repair prior service-code fidelity by encoding the documented CIP Start service 0x06 inside a valid registered-session SendRRData request.
expected_behavior: The endpoint should parse the valid explicit-message wrapper and reach CIP service dispatch for Start or return a normal unsupported-service/object error.
constraints_preserved: Documented CIP Start service code 0x06 is used.
SendRRData outer length is exact at 20 bytes.
CPF item count is 2 with Null Address plus Unconnected Data items.
Unconnected Data Item length is 6 and matches the CIP bytes.
CIP path size is 2 words with four bytes of request path.
issue_safety_notes: This corrects the prior wrong-service issue while keeping the payload minimal and structurally valid.
